responsibility: Declares the reusable C-syntax pretty-printer class and helper APIs shared by C and C++ front ends. It defines c_pretty_printer’s virtual interface for printing expressions, declarations, statements, and types, its formatting flags and callback slots for grammar-sensitive productions, and the token-formatting helper functions implemented in c-pretty-print.cc.
same_name_distinction: Declaration header for the reusable C-family pretty printer: it specifies the c_pretty_printer class interface and helper prototypes, while c-pretty-print.cc supplies the concrete printing behavior for trees, expressions, declarations, and statements.
